gloss: usable in both sun and rain; all-weather

definitions.gloss: usable in both sun and rain; all-weather (umbrella, etc.)
definitions.explanation: Describes an item — most often an umbrella or parasol — that can be used both as a sunshade and for rain. Standard product-category label in Japanese shops.

examples.japanese: {晴雨兼用|せいうけんよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{日傘|ひがさ}→日傘：04686_higasa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{晴雨兼用|せいうけんよう}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: This parasol is convenient because it works in both sun and rain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧な⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧、{晴雨兼用|せいうけんよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{折|お}りたたみ→折りたたみ：11332_oritatami⟧{傘|がさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち{歩|ある}いている→持ち歩く：05739_mochiaruku⟧。
examples.english: I carry a folding all-weather umbrella so I'm ready for sudden rain.

notes:
Compound of {晴|せい} (clear) + {雨|う} (rain) + ⟦{兼用|けんよう}→兼用：15781_kenyou⟧ (combined use). Almost always used as a noun modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {晴雨兼用|せいうけんよう}{傘|がさ}: all-weather umbrella
- {晴雨兼用|せいうけんよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日傘|ひがさ}→日傘：04686_higasa⟧: all-weather parasol
- {晴雨兼用|せいうけんよう}⟦タイプ→タイプ：01534_taipu⟧: all-weather type/model

USAGE:
Frequently seen on product tags and signage in department stores and online retail. The opposite category labels are ⟦{雨傘|あまがさ}→雨傘：19849_amagasa⟧⟦{専用|せんよう}→専用：12385_senyou⟧ (rain only) and ⟦{日傘|ひがさ}→日傘：04686_higasa⟧⟦{専用|せんよう}→専用：12385_senyou⟧ (sun only).
